summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of a USD 500 million senior unsecured fixed-rate notes issuance under its USD 7.5 billion Global Medium Term Note Programme, executed through its IFSC Banking Unit. The notes carry ratings of BBB from S&P Global and Baa3 from Moody's and will be listed on India International Exchange IFSC, NSE IFSC, and SGX-ST. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction with no equity component, board recommendation, or special-situation characteristics. The offering is not registered in the United States, and no further corporate action is anticipated beyond the successful placement.
